# Mahim (Mahim Ibne Khudi) - Official Profile & Portfolio

> Official website: https://mahims.com
> Primary Profession: Professional Graphic Designer & Brand Identity Specialist
> Location: Gaibandha & Dhaka, Bangladesh
> Education: Dhaka Central University (Political Science)

## About Mahim
Mahim (full name: Mahim Ibne Khudi / মাহিম ইবনে খুদি) is a Bangladeshi creative graphic designer, brand strategist, and visual content creator. With years of practical experience, he specializes in high-converting social media creatives, corporate brand identity systems, modern typography, and print design.

## Core Specializations & Skills
- **Graphic Design & Branding**: Brand identity development, logo design, visual style guides, and promotional design.
- **Social Media Marketing**: Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn ad creatives, campaign posters, carousels, and banners.
- **Software Proficiency**: Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, Canva Pro, Figma.
- **Academic Background**: Student of Political Science at Dhaka Central University.
- **Community Work**: Creative designer for Alokito Gaibandha.
